name: Yahata Reika
source:
A composed, gifted college student. 
Abducted while on campus.

Looks at everything through cold, rational eyes, and ready to kill if it means ensuring her own survival.
Though smart, she lacks any sort of special abilities beyond that of an ordinary student.

"How can you be so optimistic, Souichi?"

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=614865]Getchu[/url]]
